title: Time Jump: 2:00 — Forensic Evidence Confirmed

fields.narration: It is now 2:00. The forensic evidence is in. The 915 MHz C2 link was compromised via an unauthorized remote session from IP 192.168.100.22 at 09:12. The session modified the home point and altered the flight path. The IP is not in the Group’s approved vendor list. The GCS-01 logs confirm a C2 link compromise per ISP Section 9.1. The team must now decide: keep automation or fall back to manual control.
worldState: IP 192.168.100.22 is not in the Group’s approved vendor list.
The C2 link compromise is confirmed via GCS-01 logs and RTK-1 base telemetry.
The home point was modified remotely at 09:12 via the 915 MHz C2 link.
The flight path was altered by unauthorized command injection.
UAS-11 remains airborne and on an uncommanded trajectory toward Millstone Creek.
The RTK-1 base (SM-L1) and GCS-01 are in a compromised state; no further automated commands may be trusted.
The aircraft is now 120 meters from the lake edge and descending toward the water at 2.3 m/s.
All evidence has been preserved: full telemetry, link logs, and RTK base logs are on HUOG-NAS01 and the managed SOC has imaging access.
fields.facilitatorNote: This is a decision point inject. The IC must now choose between keeping automation (risking a water recovery) or switching to manual/attitude mode (risking a crash but preserving the aircraft). Watch for hesitation, misalignment on C2 link and GCS state, and failure to consult the ISP or ERP.
